title: Quick-fill Malta expense planner
intro: A blank-by-default planner for 13–19 October 2026. Enter euros on a consistent whole-trip or party basis, preview itinerary matches and record each cost once. Published references are not personal quotes; no amount, purchase, ride count, party size or reimbursement is assumed.

records.name: Flights — all travelers
records.address: Not applicable — editable expense category
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Enter the booked round-trip total, including baggage, seat selection, payment fees, and any changes. Departure airport, airline, traveler count, and booking price have not been provided; do not assume a U.S. gateway or flight itinerary.
records.notes: Malta Airport’s airline directory is for route/provider discovery, not a fare quote. Enter the total from the selected airline’s booking or receipt; if charged in USD, convert using the card/statement rate and note the conversion or fee.
records.price range: Not published; budget and actual fields start blank

records.name: AX ODYCY — full accommodation booking total
records.address: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
records.hours: Not applicable — enter the full booking total and note the confirmed check-in/out dates
records.description: Hotel and Deluxe Sea-View room are user-supplied trip details. No booking confirmation, price, deposit, meal plan, traveler count, or exact check-in/out time was supplied. Enter the confirmed booking total rather than multiplying an assumed nightly rate; do not infer the number of hotel nights from the travel window alone.
records.notes: Official AX ODYCY property page; it is not a quote or confirmation of this reservation. Record any included meals, deposit, cancellation terms, and separately billed hotel charges in the notes field.
records.price range: Not published; booking amount starts blank

records.name: Hotel taxes, environmental contribution, deposits, or other separately billed charges
records.address: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Use only for separately billed hotel expenses, without duplicating the accommodation total. MTA’s guest notice and guidelines state €1.50/night for guests aged 18+ at arrival, capped at €22.50/continuous visit, separate from the room rate. Six qualifying nights would be €9 per eligible adult as arithmetic only; enter your actual invoice and party details. A refundable deposit or card hold is not a consumed expense—track it in notes and count it as spending only if retained.
records.notes: Fresh guest notice: https://cms.mta.com.mt/api/media/file/2026%20Regulations%20-%20Notice%20to%20Guests.pdf . Per-night rule also in https://mta.com.mt/docs/Eco-Contribution-Accommodation-Guidelines-2026.pdf . The general service page https://mta.com.mt/services/environmental-contribution/ retains anomalous “exceeded fifteen (15) nights” wording; this is not treated as a short-stay exemption. Confirm the hotel invoice, eligible ages and actual billable nights. No amount prefilled.
records.price range: Published €1.50/night/eligible adult, cap €22.50/continuous visit. Conditional six-night example €9/adult; personal invoice unknown.

records.name: Travel / medical insurance
records.address: Not applicable — editable expense category
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Enter the premium and any separately paid coverage or add-ons after comparing the actual policy terms. The traveler’s existing cover and policy cost are unknown.
records.notes: U.S. Department of State travel guidance; it is not an insurance quote and applies as U.S. guidance. Verify medical, evacuation, trip-cancellation, and activity coverage with the selected insurer.
records.price range: Not published; quote and purchase amount start blank

records.name: Passport / entry-document costs, if applicable
records.address: Not applicable — depends on passport and personal circumstances
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Optional line for a renewal, document, or other applicable entry-related fee. Passport nationality and expiration date are unknown; do not assume a visa or renewal is required.
records.notes: The U.S. State Department page is relevant only if traveling on a U.S. passport. Check the current official rules and fee schedule for the passport actually used; no fee has been entered.
records.price range: Not published; no fee assumed

records.name: Airport → AX ODYCY transfer
records.address: Malta International Airport to the confirmed AX ODYCY entrance
records.hours: Not applicable — enter the selected arrival transfer total
records.description: Enter the total for the arrival-day option actually selected: public bus, taxi/ride-hailing, or another transfer. Flight arrival time and selected service are not supplied.
records.notes: Malta Public Transport’s Airport Direct information is one public-bus reference, not a final hotel transfer plan or the price of every mode. Check the live journey planner and current fare before travel.
records.price range: Not published for the traveler’s chosen option; input starts blank

records.name: AX ODYCY → airport transfer
records.address: The confirmed AX ODYCY entrance to Malta International Airport
records.hours: Not applicable — enter the selected departure transfer total
records.description: Enter the return-to-airport amount after the departure flight and chosen transport option are known. Do not assume a bus schedule, taxi quote, or departure time.
records.notes: Official Airport Direct reference only; confirm a date/time-specific route and live service notices before relying on a bus.
records.price range: Not published for the traveler’s chosen option; input starts blank

records.name: Local buses / travel cards
records.address: Not applicable — editable expense category
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Enter the actual card purchase or individual fares you choose, counted once. Compare route coverage, validity, activation and expected boardings before buying. Published fare/card references are in the transport guide; the applicable October single fare and the best-value product for your itinerary remain to be confirmed.
records.notes: Use https://www.publictransport.com.mt/fares-and-tickets/ and the transport guide’s dated fare/card records. The only explicit winter validity seen ends 13 June 2026; do not infer an October changeover. Airport Direct/TD inclusions need product-specific confirmation. No card is automatically better because the stay lasts six nights. Budget defaults stay blank.
records.price range: Not set; check current fares and card conditions

records.name: AX ODYCY ↔ BLAST Arena Studios event-day travel
records.address: From AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, to the confirmed MFCC/BLAST Arena Studios entrance
records.hours: Not applicable — enter the chosen event-day round-trip amount
records.description: Optional category for the event commute. Route 186 is a candidate, not a saved door-to-door journey. Confirm the actual gate, required arrival, outward route and a separate return before allocating fares or rides. Count these costs here OR in the general bus/taxi rows, never both.
records.notes: Official journey planner reference only. The transport guide treats Route 186 as a candidate, not a saved date-specific journey or guaranteed last-bus return. The October 17–18 notice omits a year; April’s 20:00 notice is separate. Check both directions, attendee gate and actual timetable before choosing a mode. Count each receipt in either this row or the general transport rows, never twice.
records.price range: Not set; exact date/time route and event return are not confirmed

records.name: Taxi / ride-hailing
records.address: Not applicable — enter only trips you plan to take
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Enter the rides actually planned or taken, using live quotes or receipts. A hotel-arranged fixed-charge taxi is another option to request; no five-ride purchase or universal late-bus absence is assumed. Confirm availability, pickup point, waiting and cancellation terms.
records.notes: AX ODYCY advertises Guest Relations taxi arrangements with fixed charges but no rate card: https://axhotelsmalta.com/odycy/faqs/?faq=check-in-out . The regulator’s published metered reference has a 06/04/2022 webpage date: https://www.transport.gov.mt/land/public-transport/other-public-transport/taxis-829 . Hypothetical distance-band arithmetic is not a quote or a confirmed current ceiling. Compare actual licensed-provider/app/hotel offers and do not double-count the event-commute row.
records.price range: Live quote varies; no amount prefilled

records.name: Optional car hire, fuel, parking, and insurance excess
records.address: Malta International Airport rental-car area, if collecting there
records.hours: Not applicable — include only if a car is actually booked
records.description: Optional cost bucket for a rental car and related charges. No rental booking, driver, vehicle, fuel use, parking plan, or insurance terms are assumed.
records.notes: Airport page gives rental-car information, not a quote. Use the selected rental company’s final terms and include any excess, fuel, parking, and add-ons that apply.
records.price range: Live booking/vehicle quote required; no amount prefilled

records.name: Meals, cafés, snacks, and drinks
records.address: Not applicable — use the chosen restaurant/shop receipts or quotes
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Enter the planned or actual total for meals and drinks. Consider noting whether hotel meals are included, and avoid adding an included meal twice.
records.notes: Minoa is one official sample menu, not a general Malta price guide or a required restaurant. See the site’s food page for the broader shortlist; all actual spending remains user-entered.
records.price range: No daily allowance or meal price assumed; input starts blank

records.name: Landmarks, museums, boat trips, and other activities
records.address: Not applicable — enter only selected visits/tickets
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Use this line for admission, guided tours, ferry/boat excursions, or other sightseeing that you actually select. Some sites require advance booking; confirm the current ticket, date, and access before entering a budget.
records.notes: The link is one official example of a ticketed site; it is not a planned activity or a price for every attraction. See the activities page for the sourced shortlist and current caveats.
records.price range: Varies by site and ticket; no visit or ticket assumed

records.name: Gaming centres, arcade, VR, and esports activities
records.address: Not applicable — enter only selected activities
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Enter any confirmed gaming-centre, arcade, VR, or esports activity spend. Venue availability and status can change; no visit is assumed.
records.notes: The Eden’s XP Arcade page is a venue-specific reference, not a general gaming price or a commitment to visit. Check the activities page for other venue-status caveats.
records.price range: Varies by venue/package; no activity assumed

records.name: Thunderpick event ticket / spectator access, if applicable
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta — the address on the event’s own ticketing listing.
records.hours: Wednesday 14 – Sunday 18 October 2026, 9:30 AM – 10 PM. Check-in 09:30 and games 10:30 on 14 and 15 October; check-in 14:00 and games 15:00 on 16 October. Ages 18+.
records.description: The event listing advertises free 18+ reservation, but inventory, your reservation, per-day validity and actual expenses are not confirmed. Enter only your confirmed ticket amount; put transport, meals and other costs in their appropriate rows so they are counted once. Free advertised admission does not make the whole event day free.
records.notes: Eventbrite read 11 October 2026 advertises free in-person ages-18+ reservations for 14–18 October: https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/hotspawn-present-the-thunderpick-world-championships-2026-tickets-1988838616841 . The headline ends at 22:00 but visible Wed/Thu agenda rows end at 22:30 and Friday at 21:00; confirm times and timezone. Saturday/Sunday rows and FAQ answers were not visible in the extraction, not proven unpublished. No reservation or inventory check was completed. Per-day validity, gate, parking and catering remain open. Keep food, transport and other spending in their own rows, not in admission again.
records.price range: Free “Reserve a spot” advertised on the checked listing. Your reservation, current availability, fee total and day validity are unconfirmed; enter only the actual ticket/fee amount, including zero if confirmed.

records.name: Mobile data, local SIM/eSIM, or U.S. carrier roaming
records.address: Not applicable — depends on the phone and carrier plan
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Enter the selected local SIM/eSIM purchase or the carrier’s confirmed roaming total. Phone model, unlock/eSIM compatibility, and U.S. carrier rates are not known.
records.notes: GO provider page is one local prepaid reference; it is not the traveler’s roaming quote or a recommendation to switch. Check the existing U.S. carrier and device first.
records.price range: Plan-specific; no purchase or roaming charge assumed

records.name: ATM, foreign-transaction, card, and currency-conversion fees
records.address: Not applicable — depends on the card issuer and ATM
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Enter only fees you expect or actually pay for ATM withdrawals, card use, or converting USD charges to euros. No exchange rate or fee is assumed.
records.notes: The Government of Malta page is a currency reference, not a U.S. bank fee schedule. Check your card issuer for foreign-transaction fees, ATM fees, and its posted conversion rate.
records.price range: Unknown; check the U.S. bank/card terms

records.address: Not applicable — editable catch-all expense category
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Use for small purchases or costs that do not fit another row. Add a short explanation in the notes field and avoid double-counting items already included elsewhere.
records.notes: VisitMalta is a discovery link, not an incidentals price source. No amount has been estimated or prefilled.
records.price range: User-entered; starts blank

records.description: Use for meals, incidentals or other daily spending not already entered in the core trip categories. Do not count a bus pass, hotel charge or meal twice. Add the day’s plan or receipt references in notes.
records.notes: This is a traveler-input template, not a sourced itinerary or price estimate. Government source supports euro currency only. Enter whole-day costs here OR in corresponding aggregate categories, not both. Do not include private payment or identity data.
